task: Build a tree: a trunk rising from the ground with a leafy canopy above it. The canopy may be several separate clumps of leaves. Around 10 to 40 cells tall and 5 to 30 across, using at least 150 voxels in all.
notes: Deliberately silent about components and floating parts. Clumps of leaves that don't touch are a tree, not a defect — the very numbers that fail `standing-chair` are expected here. That is what it means for the report to state measurements and leave the verdict to the case; a grader that hard-coded 'one component, nothing floating' would mark a correct tree wrong.
